escalationPolicies.name: Unreported Down Link Auto-Dispatch (15 Min)
escalationPolicies.triggerCondition: Any Cathedral of Praise link has an active Outage Ticket AND "Reported to Telco" is "No" for > 15 minutes
escalationPolicies.notifyTargets: Duty NOC Engineer + Auto-Dispatch Email to Provider NOC (Eastern / Converge / PLDT / Starlink)
escalationPolicies.autoAction: Automatically creates and sends Outage Email with exact Circuit ID / Account # to the Telco Provider NOC and updates Reported to Telco = Yes.

escalationPolicies.level: L2 - Regional Network Lead & Telco Account Mgr
escalationPolicies.name: Waiting for Telco Repair — Missing Telco Ticket # or Approaching ETR
escalationPolicies.triggerCondition: Status is "Waiting for Telco Repair" AND (Telco Ticket # is still pending > 30m OR within 30m of Provider ETR)
escalationPolicies.notifyTargets: Network Infrastructure Lead + Telco Account Manager
escalationPolicies.autoAction: Dispatches Urgent Follow-Up / ETR Chaser Email to Provider NOC + CC Account Manager.

escalationPolicies.level: L3 - VP Infrastructure & Telco Executive Desk
escalationPolicies.name: Provider ETR Breached / Multi-Link Campus Outage (> 240 Min)
escalationPolicies.triggerCondition: Current time exceeds Provider Expected Resolution Timeline (ETR) OR both Transport & Internet links on a Campus are RED (Down)
escalationPolicies.notifyTargets: IT Director, Campus Administration, Telco Escalation Desk
escalationPolicies.autoAction: Escalates incident to L3 Executive Tier and dispatches formal SLA Breach Notice.
